archive: archive/ holds past editions: read only, never run; to rerun one, use the old release install.
step: step 1 IDEA of AGENTS.md (read its page); SCOUT runs it after registry_build_v2 and scoreboard_v2
question: Which metric codes do the registry's alarms read (with their results), and which OK codes does no alarm read yet, per idea family?
usage_from_code: python3 -B <Alarm>/08_Registry/tree/ALARM_DESIGN/REGISTRY/tools/inputs_read_v1.py --settings <settings file> [--registry REGISTRY/ALARM_REGISTRY_V1.tsv] [--tags REGISTRY/FAMILY_TAGS_V1.tsv] [--out REGISTRY/INPUTS_READ_V1.tsv] [--page REGISTRY/INPUTS_READ_V1.md]

commands.name: build

args.name: --settings
args.meaning: this machine's settings file (KEY=VALUE lines read by _tools/settings_v1.py); always named on the command line

args.name: --registry
args.meaning: the registry (default REGISTRY/ALARM_REGISTRY_V1.tsv; relative: under RESEARCH_ROOT/ALARM_DESIGN)

args.name: --tags
args.meaning: the family tags, columns alarm_id and family (default REGISTRY/FAMILY_TAGS_V1.tsv)

args.name: --out
args.meaning: the table to write, one row per code (default REGISTRY/INPUTS_READ_V1.tsv); twinned first when it exists

args.name: --page
args.meaning: the page to write, per family and per group (default REGISTRY/INPUTS_READ_V1.md); twinned first when it exists

commands.writes: the --out table and the --page page (both outside the Alarm folder, under RESEARCH_ROOT/ALARM_DESIGN by default; a file that exists is twinned first)

refuses.when: no --settings; a settings file the reader refuses (RESEARCH_ROOT empty among them); an --out or --page inside the Alarm package; this file outside an Alarm package; a missing metric table or metric_brief_v2.py

commands.does: writes the inputs table and its page from the registry, its definitions, the family tags and the metric tables of this Alarm folder

rules: a code is read when an input of a definition names it; how the alarm reads it (window, line, moment) is not compared: a new moment on a read code needs its reason in the card
a definition missing, changed since its decision (sha16) or not JSON is counted on the page and skipped, never read as reading nothing
the flags are metric_brief_v2's words (the same table the detector's admission reads in this Alarm folder); the families are SCOUT's classification, an opinion
no dry mode: the docs test writes only into its planted temp data

outputs.where: stdout, one line when both files are written

dry_run_data: planted by _tools/tests/test_agent_docs_v1.py in a new temp folder: {SETTINGS} its settings file, {WORLD} the folder, {ALARM} this Alarm folder; the planted registry's definitions are not there, so they are counted as missing
